subject.title: fix: WebChat stop fails for WeChat channel sessions

question: Should this narrower selected-channel `/stop` fix land independently before the broader WebChat Stop recovery work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92003?
rationale: The patch is focused and well-proven, but it intentionally changes hidden channel run matching, reply-run registry aborts, WebChat session selection, and TUI diagnostic behavior, so session/message-delivery risk and landing order need maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Land after CI refresh
options.body: Accept the supplied selected WeChat, main-session negative, and multi-channel isolation proof, refresh exact-head checks or rebase if needed, and keep broader same-session Stop recovery separate.

options.title: Wait for broader recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the broader WebChat Stop recovery PR should absorb or precede the channel-session targeting change.

options.title: Request owner smoke
options.body: Ask an owner to run an exact-head selected-channel WebChat stop smoke if independent confirmation is needed before accepting the session/message-delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Land after CI refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the supplied selected WeChat, main-session negative, and multi-channel isolation proof, refresh exact-head checks or rebase if needed, and keep broader same-session Stop recovery separate.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available combination of adjacent WebChat/Gateway history and recent review context on the related Stop recovery session-state boundary.
